meanings.usage: 指从沉船或废墟中救出财物
指船上的所有工作人员
指国家的主体部分，不包括岛屿
指未经加工的贵重金属
指用工具或方法仔细搜寻某区域
形容规模或程度非常大
常用复数形式，指个人物品
指一起旅行或被护送的船队或车队
指能在水下航行的船只
sink的过去分词作形容词用

examples.en: The captain was instructed to give up the search.
There was tremendous excitement on board.
The crew were at first under the impression that the lost ship had been found.
examples.zh: 船员们最初以为找到了那艘失踪的船。

examples.en: The numerous items were brought to the surface.
The captain was able to piece together all the information.
examples.zh: 船长能够拼凑出所有的信息。

examples.en: Information that had come to light was collected.
examples.zh: 被揭露的信息被收集起来。

examples.en: The captain of the Elkor ordered his men to salvage as much as possible.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号船长命令他的手下尽可能多地打捞。

examples.en: Elkor had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号已经在巴伦支海搜索了数周。

examples.en: What they had in fact found was a ship which had been sunk many years before.
examples.zh: 他们实际上发现的是一艘很多年前沉没的船。

examples.en: This was later confirmed by a naval official.
examples.zh: 这后来被一位海军官员证实。

phrases.usage: /ˈlɒɡ bʊk/ noun. 航海日志（记录船舶航行情况的日志）
/piːs təˈɡeðər/ verb phrase. 拼凑；整合（指将零散的信息拼凑成完整画面）

grammar.title: 过去完成进行时 (Past Perfect Continuous)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经开始并持续到该时刻的动作，或刚刚结束的动作 用于描述持续进行的动作，常与for/during等时间词连用，强调动作的持续性

examples.en: Elkor had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks.
examples.zh: 埃尔科号已经在巴伦支海搜索了数周。

grammar.title: 过去完成时被动态 (Past Perfect Passive)
grammar.definition: 过去完成时的被动语态，表示在过去某时刻之前已经完成且承受动作的主语 强调动作的完成性和被动性，主语是动作的承受者

examples.en: The sunken ship he was trying to find had been carrying a precious cargo of gold bullion.
examples.zh: 他试图寻找的沉船一直载有贵重的金条。

original.en: The sea bed was scoured with powerful nets and there was tremendous excitement on board when a chest was raised from the bottom.
original.zh: 用强力网搜寻海底，当一个箱子从海底被吊起时，船上非常兴奋。

imitations.en: The police had been searching the area for hours when they finally found the missing child.
imitations.zh: 警察在该地区搜索了几个小时，终于找到了失踪的孩子。

original.en: Despite the message, the captain of the Elkor decided to try once more.
original.zh: 尽管收到了消息，埃尔科号的船长决定再试一次。

imitations.en: Despite the heavy rain, we continued our journey.
imitations.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们继续赶路。

original.en: The captain learnt from the letter that the name of the lost ship was the Karen.
original.zh: 船长从信中得知失踪船只的名字是凯伦号。

imitations.en: The detective realized that the suspect had been lying.
imitations.zh: 侦探意识到嫌疑人一直在撒谎。

original.en: The Karen had been sailing in a convoy to Russia when she was torpedoed by an enemy submarine.
original.zh: 凯伦号正在护航队中驶向俄罗斯时被敌方潜艇发射鱼雷击中。

imitations.en: He had been driving for three hours when his car broke down.
imitations.zh: 他已经开了三个小时的车，这时他的车抛锚了。

lines.en: The salvage operation had been a complete failure.
The small ship, Elkor, which had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks, was on its way home.
lines.zh: 小船“埃尔科”号在巴伦支海搜寻了几个星期之后，正在返航途中。

lines.en: A radio message from the mainland had been received by the ship's captain instructing him to give up the search.
lines.zh: 返航前，该船船长收到了大陆发来的电报，指示他们放弃这次搜寻。

lines.en: The captain knew that another attempt would be made later, for the sunken ship he was trying to find had been carrying a precious cargo of gold bullion Despite the message, the captain of the Elkor decided to try once more.
lines.zh: 船长知道日后还会再作尝试，因为他试图寻找的沉船上载有一批珍贵的金条。尽管船长接了电报，他还是决定再试一试。

lines.en: The sea bed was scoured with powerful nets and there was tremendous excitement on board went a chest was raised from the bottom.
lines.zh: 他们用结实的网把海床搜索了一遍。

lines.en: Though the crew were at first under the impression that the lost ship had been found, the contents of the chest proved them wrong.
lines.zh: 当一只箱子从海底被打捞上来时，甲板上人们激动不已。

lines.en: What they had in fact found was a ship which had been sunk many years before.
lines.zh: 船员们开始认为沉船找着了，但海底沉箱内的物品证明他们弄错了。

lines.en: The chest contained the personal belongings of a seaman , Alan Fielding.
lines.zh: 事实上，他们发现的是另一艘沉没多年的船。

lines.en: There were books, clothing and photographs, together with letters which the seaman had once received from his wife.
The captain of the Elkor ordered his men to salvage as much as possible from the wreck .
lines.zh: 菲尔丁的私人财物，其中有书箱、衣服、照片以及水手收到的妻子的来信。

lines.en: Nothing of value was found, but the numerous items which were brought to the surface proved to be of great interest.
lines.zh: “埃尔科”号船长命令船员们尽量从沉船中打捞物品，但没发现什么值钱的东西，不过打捞出来的众多的物品还是引起了大家极大的兴趣。

lines.en: From a heavy gun that was raised, the captain realized that the ship must have been a cruiser.
lines.zh: 从捞起的一门大炮来看，船长认为那艘船一定是艘巡洋舰。

lines.en: In another chest, which contained the belongings of a ship's officer, there was an unfinished letter which had been written on March 14th, 1943.
lines.zh: 另一只海底沉箱中装的是船上一位军官的财物，其中有一封写于1943年3月14日的信，但没有写完。

lines.en: The captain learnt from the letter that the name of the lost ship was the Karen.
lines.zh: 从这封信中船长了解到沉船船名是“卡伦”号。

lines.en: The most valuable find of all was the ship's log book, parts of which it was still possible to read.
lines.zh: 打捞到的东西中最有价值的是船上的航海日志，其中有一部分仍然清晰可读。

lines.en: From this the captain was able to piece together all the information that had come to light.
lines.zh: 据此，船长可以将所有的那些已经搞清的材料拼凑起来。

lines.en: The Karen had been sailing in a convoy to Russia when she was torpedoed by an enemy submarine.
lines.zh: “卡伦”号当年在为其他船只护航驶往俄国的途中突然遭到敌方潜水艇鱼雷的袭击。

lines.en: This was later confirmed by naval official at the Ministry of Defiance after the Elkor had returned home.
lines.zh: 这一说法在“埃尔科”号返航后得到的国防部一位海军官员的证实。

lines.en: All the items that were found were sent to the War Museum.
lines.zh: 那次打捞到的所有物品均被送往军事博物馆。

questions.q: Did the crew of the Elkor find what they were looking for? Why?
questions.zh: “埃尔科”号的船员找到他们要找的东西了吗？为什么？
questions.a: No, they didn't. They were looking for a sunken ship that had been carrying a precious cargo of gold bullion, but they never found it. Instead, they found another ship—the Karen—which had been sunk many years before.
questions.aZh: 没有。他们要找的是一艘载有珍贵金条的沉船，却始终没找到；他们找到的是另一艘沉没多年的船——“卡伦”号。
questions.hint: 课文第1、4句点明打捞彻底失败、目标是金条；第6、7句说明捞上来的其实是另一艘沉船。

questions.q: What did the captain do despite receiving the radio message?
questions.zh: 尽管收到了电报，船长做了什么？
questions.a: Despite the message, the captain of the Elkor decided to try once more.
questions.aZh: 尽管接到了电报，“埃尔科”号的船长还是决定再试一次。
questions.hint: 课文第4句末：'Despite the message, the captain... decided to try once more.'

questions.q: What did the chest that was raised from the sea bed contain?
questions.zh: 从海床捞上来的那只箱子里装的是什么？
questions.a: It contained the personal belongings of a seaman, Alan Fielding—books, clothing and photographs, together with letters which the seaman had once received from his wife.
questions.aZh: 里面装着水手艾伦·菲尔丁的私人物品——书籍、衣服、照片，以及他曾经从妻子那里收到的信件。
questions.hint: 课文第8、9句：'The chest contained the personal belongings of a seaman, Alan Fielding.'

questions.q: How was the name of the lost ship discovered?
questions.zh: 沉船的名字是怎样被发现的？
questions.a: In another chest containing a ship's officer's belongings there was an unfinished letter written on March 14th, 1943, and from it the captain learnt that the name of the lost ship was the Karen.
questions.aZh: 在另一只装有船上军官财物的箱子里，有一封写于1943年3月14日却未写完的信，船长从信中得知沉船名叫“卡伦”号。
questions.hint: 课文第13、14句：from the unfinished letter the captain learnt the name was the Karen。

questions.q: Why was the ship's log book the most valuable find of all?
questions.zh: 为什么航海日志是打捞到的最有价值的东西？
questions.a: Because parts of it were still readable, and from it the captain was able to piece together all the information that had come to light—that the Karen had been sailing in a convoy to Russia when she was torpedoed by an enemy submarine.
questions.aZh: 因为日志有一部分仍清晰可读，船长据此可以拼凑出所有已经得以查明的情况——“卡伦”号当年在护航驶往俄国途中被敌方潜艇用鱼雷击沉。
questions.hint: 课文第15、16、17句：log book → piece together the information → torpedoed by an enemy submarine。

translation:
打捞工作彻底失败了。
小船“埃尔科”号在巴伦支海搜寻了几个星期之后，正在返航途中。
返航前，该船船长收到了大陆发来的电报，指示他们放弃这次搜寻。
船长知道日后还会再作尝试，因为他试图寻找的沉船上载有一批珍贵的金条。
尽管船长接了电报，他还是决定再试一试。
他们用结实的网把海床搜索了一遍。
当一只箱子从海底被打捞上来时，甲板上人们激动不已。
船员们开始认为沉船找着了，但海底沉箱内的物品证明他们弄错了。
事实上，他们发现的是另一艘沉没多年的船。
木箱内装有水手艾伦。
菲尔丁的私人财物，其中有书箱、衣服、照片以及水手收到的妻子的来信。
“埃尔科”号船长命令船员们尽量从沉船中打捞物品，但没发现什么值钱的东西，不过打捞出来的众多的物品还是引起了大家极大的兴趣。
从捞起的一门大炮来看，船长认为那艘船一定是艘巡洋舰。
另一只海底沉箱中装的是船上一位军官的财物，其中有一封写于1943年3月14日的信，但没有写完。
从这封信中船长了解到沉船船名是“卡伦”号。
打捞到的东西中最有价值的是船上的航海日志，其中有一部分仍然清晰可读。
据此，船长可以将所有的那些已经搞清的材料拼凑起来。
“卡伦”号当年在为其他船只护航驶往俄国的途中突然遭到敌方潜水艇鱼雷的袭击。
这一说法在“埃尔科”号返航后得到的国防部一位海军官员的证实。
那次打捞到的所有物品均被送往军事博物馆。
title: A Lost Ship
subtitle: 一艘失踪的船

lead.question: 打捞“埃尔科”号的船员找到他们想找的沉船了吗？他们最终发现了什么？
lead.warmup: 打捞（salvage）失败后，小船“埃尔科”号正返航。船长收到大陆电报，命他放弃搜寻，可那艘沉船载着珍贵的金条（gold bullion），他决定再试一次。他们用大网搜索海床（sea bed），捞起一只只箱子。船员们原以为找到了目标，箱中之物却证明他们弄错了。本课用倒叙与被动语态，讲述一次意外的发现。
goals: 读懂课文大意：一次失败的打捞如何意外揭开“卡伦”号的谜团
掌握本课核心词汇：salvage、wreck、cargo、log book、sea bed 等
熟练运用过去完成时（had + 过去分词）表示更早的过去
辨析被动语态与过去完成时结合（had been done）的用法
lead.summary: “埃尔科”号的打捞一度彻底失败。船长不顾电报，决定再试一次，用强力网遍搜海床。一只箱子被捞起，船员们以为找到了目标，里面却是水手菲尔丁的私人物品。一门大炮表明那是艘巡洋舰，一封未写完的信透露船名“卡伦”号，航海日志帮船长拼凑出它的遭遇：1943年护航驶往俄国时被敌方潜艇击沉。
lead.tips: 注意过去完成时与被动语态叠加时的语序：had + been + 过去分词，如 had been sunk、had been written，切勿漏掉 been。

exercises.q: 汉译英：打捞工作彻底失败了。
exercises.a: The salvage operation had been a complete failure.
exercises.note: 过去完成时的被动语态

exercises.q: 用 be 的适当形式填空：The sea bed ___ (scour) with powerful nets, and a chest ___ (raise) from the bottom.
exercises.note: 一般过去时的被动语态

exercises.q: 把主动句改成被动句：An enemy submarine torpedoed the Karen.
exercises.a: The Karen was torpedoed by an enemy submarine.

exercises.q: 改错：The captain knew that another attempt will be made later.
exercises.a: The captain knew that another attempt would be made later.

exercises.q: 汉译英：船长命令船员们尽量从沉船中打捞物品。
exercises.a: The captain of the Elkor ordered his men to salvage as much as possible from the wreck.

exercises.q: 用分词短语改写：a ship which had been sunk many years before
exercises.a: a ship sunk many years before

exercises.q: 填空：The most valuable find of all was the ship's ___ ___, parts of which it was still possible to read.

quiz.q: 课文开头说打捞工作“彻底失败了”，正确的英文表达是？
options: The salvage operation had been a complete failure.
The salvage operation had been completely failed.
The salvage operation was a complete failure had been.
The salvage operation had been a complete succeed.
quiz.note: salvage operation + 过去完成时被动

quiz.q: “埃尔科”号船长收到电报后的决定是？
options: He gave up the search at once.
He decided to try once more.
He returned home without delay.
He sent a message to the mainland.
quiz.note: Despite the message... decided to try once more

quiz.q: 从海底捞起的那只箱子里装的是谁的物品？
options: A ship's officer.
A naval official.
A seaman named Alan Fielding.
The captain's wife.
quiz.note: the personal belongings of a seaman, Alan Fielding

quiz.q: 船长根据什么判断那艘船是巡洋舰（cruiser）？
options: A letter written on March 14th, 1943.
A heavy gun that was raised.
The ship's log book.
A photograph of the crew.
quiz.note: From a heavy gun that was raised...

quiz.q: 沉船“卡伦”号当年遭遇了什么？
options: It was wrecked in a storm.
It was torpedoed by an enemy submarine while sailing in a convoy to Russia.
It was abandoned by its crew.
It hit rocks near the Barents Sea.
quiz.note: sailing in a convoy to Russia... torpedoed by an enemy submarine

quiz.q: 打捞到的所有物品最后被送往哪里？
options: The Ministry of Defence.
The Barents Sea Museum.
The War Museum.
The ship's home port.
quiz.note: All the items... were sent to the War Museum
